settingsConfig.remedy: Run `hyprlayer thoughts init` in a repository, or add a project from the app to bootstrap the config.

binaries.remedy: Install Claude Code from https://claude.com/claude-code, or set its path in Settings.

providersSessions.message: No live session with id sess-fixture
providersSessions.remedy: The session may have ended; start a new one.

projects.message: No hyprlayer project is mapped at /tmp/example-project
projects.remedy: Add the repository as a project first.

library.message: document was written but not indexable

agentsPrompts.message: That file is too large to be a prompt export.
agentsPrompts.remedy: Choose a .hlprompts file exported from Hyprlayer.

scripts.message: No run script is configured for this project.
scripts.remedy: Add commands in Project Settings → Scripts.

profileLock.message: another Hyprlayer runtime is already using the profile at /tmp/example-profile
profileLock.remedy: Quit any other Hyprlayer window or headless process using this profile, then try again.

configMigration.message: hyprlayer config is schema version 2 and needs migration to 4
configMigration.remedy: Run any hyprlayer command in a terminal (e.g. `hyprlayer storage info`) to upgrade the config file. The app picks it up on the next launch.

migrationLedgerInvalid.message: runtime migration ledger at /tmp/example-profile/runtime-migrations.json is not valid JSON: missing or non-numeric "version"
migrationLedgerInvalid.remedy: Restore runtime-migrations.json from a backup, or delete it to let migrations rerun.

migrationLedgerTooNew.message: runtime migration ledger at /tmp/example-profile/runtime-migrations.json is version 2, newer than this app supports (max 1)
migrationLedgerTooNew.remedy: Update Hyprlayer to a version that can read this profile.

projectProvisioning.remedy: Remove it first, or choose a different name or location.

libraryDocuments.message: The document changed on disk since you opened it.
libraryDocuments.remedy: Reload the document to pick up the external changes, then re-apply yours.

agentBundle.message: Bundle versions require both Claude Code and Codex to be provisioned.
agentBundle.remedy: Update the Hyprlayer CLI, then run `hyprlayer ai reinstall`.

workstreamLifecycle.message: This project already has an in-place workstream.
workstreamLifecycle.remedy: Archive it first, or create the workstream in a dedicated worktree.

npmMissing.message: Node.js (npm) isn't installed, so OpenCode can't be installed automatically.
npmMissing.remedy: Install Node.js (it includes npm) and click Refresh, or install OpenCode with Scoop (scoop install opencode), Chocolatey (choco install opencode), or WSL. You can also use Locate… to point at an existing opencode.exe.

opencodeInstallFailed.message: Couldn't install OpenCode via npm. `npm` failed with exit code 1
opencodeInstallFailed.remedy: Install Node.js/npm, or install OpenCode with Scoop (scoop install opencode), Chocolatey (choco install opencode), or WSL. then click Refresh. You can also use Locate… to point at an existing opencode.exe.

cliInstallUnsupported.message: That install method isn't available on this platform.

remoteUnsupported.message: Reveal in Finder is not available while connected to the remote host nexus.
remoteUnsupported.remedy: Do this on nexus directly, or connect to the local server.

workstreamFolderNoGit.message: This workstream runs in a plain folder, so it has no branches or PRs.

prNotFound.message: No pull request #7 found in this repository

remoteCliMissing.message: nexus does not have the Hyprlayer server this build needs.
remoteCliMissing.remedy: Install it from the Hyprlayer server panel.

remotePlatformUnsupported.message: nexus reports an unsupported platform: SunOS i86pc.
remotePlatformUnsupported.remedy: Hyprlayer's server ships for Linux x86_64, macOS arm64, and Windows x86_64.

serverDownloadFailed.remedy: No release publishes this version's server yet — stage one with scripts/stage-server-binary.sh.

remoteAuthFailed.message: Could not authenticate to nexus: Permission denied (publickey).

hostChanged.message: The active Hyprlayer server is now Nexus.
hostChanged.remedy: Relaunch Hyprlayer to connect to it.
